tasks.title: Fix src/pricing.ts
tasks.brief:
Project: /tmp/v4orch/w/t2 (node project, TypeScript files run with node --test). Fix the ONE bug in src/pricing.ts so the tests in test/pricing.test.ts pass.

Bug: applyDiscount(cents, pct) treats pct as a fraction, but its doc comment says pct is a whole percentage: applyDiscount(1000, 10) === 900. Current code is `Math.round(cents * (1 - pct))`, which gives 1000 * (1 - 10) = -9000 for pct=10. Fix it by dividing pct by 100 inside the calculation (e.g. `Math.round(cents * (1 - pct / 100))`). Change nothing else.

Scope: edit ONLY src/pricing.ts. Do not edit any test file or any other file. Do not run npm test (other files are being edited in parallel). Verify by reading the file. Report the exact line you changed.

tasks.brief:

tasks.title: Fix src/checkout.ts
tasks.brief:
Project: /tmp/v4orch/w/t2 (node project, TypeScript files run with node --test). Fix the ONE bug in src/checkout.ts so the tests in test/checkout.test.ts pass.

Bug: checkout(cart, skus, discountPct) has the doc comment "Reserves every sku (throws 'out of stock <sku>' when one can't be), then returns the cart total."
